spans.s:
ह्रेपण, अम्, n. the act of putting to shame,
excelling, surpassing.

ह्रेपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, putting to shame, outvy-
ing, surpassing.

ह्रेपित, अस्, आ, अम्, made ashamed, put to shame;
excelled, surpassed.
ह्रेप् ह्रेप्, cl. 1. A. ह्रेपते, &c., to go.

ह्रेष् ह्रेष् [cf. rt. हेष्], cl. 1. A. ह्रेषते,
जिह्रेषे, ह्रेषितुम्, to neigh (as a horse),
whinny; to creep, go [cf. rt. 1. प्रेष्]: Caus. ह्रेष-
[]
यति, &c., to make to neigh, to neigh; [cf. Gr.
χρό-μη, χρεμέθω, χρεμίζω: Old Germ. hros; Mod.
Germ. Ross; Angl. Sax. hors.]
ह्रेषा, f. neighing (of a horse), whinnying.

ह्रेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, neighed; (अम्), n. neigh-
ing.

ह्रेषुक ह्रेषुक, अस्, m. (according to some)
an instrument for digging.
